explanation: ISO week 1 is the week with the year's first Thursday, so the week from Monday 29 December 2025 to Sunday 4 January 2026 is week 1 of 2026. year() still gives the calendar year, 2025, while isoyear() gives 2026 and week() gives 1. Pairing year() with week() would label that Monday as week 1 of 2025, a week that ended almost a year earlier.
